text_block_list.text:
While Супер Крик and I are talking
about
training...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Gosh, I'm sorry. Did I startle you?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Hehe! You're such a kind soul. I'm fine.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I have a bit of a headache, but I'm sure
I'll be
right as rain in no time.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: So no need to worry, okay?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Despite what she says, she appears to be
in pain.
I should probably keep an eye
on her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
